# einksmart

> einksmart supplies Canvas color E-Ink frames, OEM inserts and project displays for B2B samples and deployments. Hardware, firmware and software scope are confirmed per model and project.

## Canvas Product Selection

- Canvas 13.3 CNC, AES-1330CNC: https://www.einksmart.com/en/products/canvas-13-3-cnc.html
- Canvas 13.3 Insert, AES-1330V: https://www.einksmart.com/en/products/canvas-13-3-insert.html
- Canvas A2 28.5, AES-2850V: https://www.einksmart.com/en/products/canvas-a2-28-5.html
- Canvas 31.5, AES-3150V: https://www.einksmart.com/en/products/canvas-31-5.html
- A1/A2/A3 open-cell panels and TCON, not finished frames: https://www.einksmart.com/en/products/e6-panel-modules.html

Sample prices are available by quotation. Scheduling, groups, CMS and API are project-scoped, not universal standard features. The expanded MagiRealm content engine is a roadmap capability. Do not infer battery runtime from image-retention power, or panel-only pricing from complete-unit quotations.
